steps.thought: List available tests to understand the station capabilities and costs.

tests.name: power_on_selftest
tests.description: Boot the unit and enumerate devices on I2C, UART and CAN.

tests.name: battery_rest_check
tests.description: Read pack and per-cell voltages at rest.

tests.name: esc_telemetry
tests.description: Read ESC telemetry: sync errors, packet loss, back-EMF detection.

tests.name: compass_static
tests.description: Compare compass heading to the fixture reference with motors off.

tests.name: harness_continuity
tests.description: Measure per-bus continuity resistance and CAN termination.

tests.name: camera_selftest
tests.description: Run camera built-in self test and measure frame rate and CSI errors.

tests.name: imu_static
tests.description: Log 1000 IMU samples on the static fixture: gyro bias, accel noise, dropouts.

tests.name: motor_spin_test
tests.description: Spin all motors at 50 percent throttle: current, RPM, RPM jitter, temp.

tests.name: compass_motor_interference
tests.description: Sweep throttle 0-75 percent and log compass heading deviation.

tests.name: battery_load_test
tests.description: Apply a 20 A load and measure sag, cell imbalance, internal resistance.

steps.thought: I will run the power_on_selftest to quickly check all communication buses and device enumeration.
steps.observation: The power_on_selftest passed successfully with all devices found on I2C, UART, and CAN, ruling out basic bus connection and boot failures.

hypotheses.rationale: Only the basic power-on selftest has been run; further subsystem tests are required to confirm health or isolate a fault.
Initial power-on self-test passed without any errors across all subsystems.

steps.thought: I will run the battery_rest_check test to verify cell voltages and rest state before loading the battery, as it is a quick and non-destructive test.
steps.observation: The battery_rest_check passed successfully with normal pack voltage and balanced cell voltages, ruling out resting battery issues.

hypotheses.rationale: Initial tests passed, but additional subsystem tests are necessary to ensure complete unit health.
Power-on self-test and battery rest checks are fully nominal.

steps.thought: I will run the esc_telemetry test to check for any commutation, sync, or packet loss issues across the ESCs.
steps.observation: The esc_telemetry test passed successfully for all four ESCs with no sync errors and normal temperatures, ruling out ESC desync or thermal derate issues.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on selftest, battery rest check, and ESC telemetry have all passed with nominal readings.
Remaining subsystems such as motors, compass, camera, IMU, and harness must still be tested.

steps.thought: Run harness_continuity to check CAN bus termination and wiring continuity.
steps.observation: The harness_continuity test passed successfully with normal bus resistance and correct CAN termination resistance, ruling out harness damage or missing CAN termination.

hypotheses.rationale: Power-on selftest, battery rest check, ESC telemetry, and harness continuity have all passed with nominal readings.
Remaining subsystems such as motors, compass, camera, IMU, and battery load must still be tested to confirm health.

steps.thought: Run motor_spin_test to check motor performance, RPM jitter, and temperature across all motors.
steps.observation: The motor_spin_test failed due to an elevated current draw on motor_1 (5.58 A against a maximum of 5.0 A), along with an elevated temperature and higher RPM jitter, while all other motors were nominal. This rules out healthy status and points directly to a motor issue on position 1.

hypotheses.rationale: High current, elevated temperature (53.4 C), and higher RPM jitter on motor_1 are classic signs of increased mechanical load from a degraded bearing.
An inter-turn winding short on motor_1 could also explain the higher current draw and elevated temperature.
Propeller imbalance can cause extra vibration and slight current increases, though usually less pronounced in current draw than mechanical friction.
